overview_faqs.question: Is WCC a good option?
overview_faqs.answer: WCC is known for its dynamic quality of education. It's 100 years of existence is a testimony by itself. It's an autonomous institution. Bagging a seat is quite a task especially at UG level. Once entered, a world of multi dimensions opens up.As far as bunking is concerned its difficult to get past the security people once inside the campus. So she will have to take leave. But 85% attendance in every subject is a deal breaker. It's important to be cautious. It's not impossible to bunk though if the right tricks are known.Discipline wise it's all individual values. Anything against the rule book is treated with stern action.Well I hope I've given you an insight about life in WCC. In a nutshell it's 70:30 ratio of education and extracurriculars for UGs and 90:10 for PGs. Good luck to both of you.

faqs.question: How can I get seat in WCC college?
faqs.answer: Candidates are offered a seat in any of the UG or PG programme of WCC based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. Departments shortlist eligible candidates according to merit in various categories and send it to the Scrutiny Committee. The college releases a selection list for each course to announce the names of shortlisted aspirants. Once the selection process is done, selected candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants further need to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the college.

faqs.question: Are admissions to various courses at Women's Christian College entrance-based?
faqs.answer: Women's Christian College does not accepts entrance exam for admission. The selection for courses is based on merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam. The department selects eligible candidates according to merit in various categories and send it to the Scrutiny Committee. Selected candidates receive admission confirmation via SMS and email. The provisional selection notice can be downloaded from the candidate login in the college website.

faqs.question: Is it hard to get into WCC College?
faqs.answer: WCC College follows a simple admission process. Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the college for the course of their choice. Once they have registered, their applications are evaluated. WCC shortlists candidates based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. Aspirants only need to ensure they score equal or above the eligibility percentage to get admission. The minimum aggregate is not defined in many of the courses. Hence, aspirants can easily get admission based on their qualification.

faqs.question: Does WCC offer better placements than Ethiraj College for Women?
faqs.answer: Ethiraj College for Women has a dedicated job placement cell and internships are an important focus for them, especially for students pursuing programs in computer science, information technology, commerce and management.Various leading recruiters like TCS, Infosys, Cognizant and HDFC Bank visit Ethiraj College campus every year to recruit students for these professional courses.On the other hand, Women's Christian College, Chennai focuses mainly on undergraduate courses in pure arts and sciences such as physics, chemistry, botany and economics rather than professional degrees.Therefore, large-scale campus placement through large recruiting firms may not be the primary focus or activity of Women's Christian College. In conclusion, Ethiraj College appears to have a clear advantage when it comes to campus placement and providing employment opportunities to graduates of professional courses. The Women's Christian College focuses more on arts-based learning than corporate internships.

faqs.question: How are the placements for B.Sc course at WCC Chennai?
faqs.answer: The WCC BSc placements vary across the BSc speacialisations offered at the college. The average package offered during BSc placements at WCC ranges between INR 2.9 Lacs and INR 3.6 lakh. Based on the student reviews available on Shiksha.com, The highest pacakge offered to BSc students of various specialisations ranged between INR 4 LPA and INR 6 LPA. Companies like Zoho, Amazon, ICICI and Infosys visit the college campus for recruitment. The students rated WCC placements at 4/5.

faqs.question: Which branch is best in B.Com at WCC?
faqs.answer: 1) Stella (Girls Only), Cathedral Road is the best branch in BCom at WCC. Its got to be at top in anybody's list. 2) MOP Vaishanav (Girls only), Thousand lights/Uttam gandhi Salai - As good as Stella. Should be in top 5 of anybody's list. 3) Ethiraj (Girls Only), Egmore- Again in top 5 for girls only 4) WCC (Girls only), College Road- I would keep it on par with Stella and MOP. You see same level of competition for seats, yet it's everyone's second or third choice for some reason . Top 5 in anybody's list 4) DG Vaishnav college (Co-ed), Arumbakkam- Only reason I would rank this below all others is it's location and plenty of parents would prefer a girls only college over a co-ed. 5) Madras Christian College (MCC), Tambaram (Co-ed)- Probably has the best campus out of the lot . Why isn't in top 5 of my pick . same reason as DG vaishnav. There are plenty of good colleges all cross the city . Above list are autonomous and self regulated, hence are preferred . Then there are alot of private colleges in far flung areas of city like SRM . I wouldn't recommend someone there.

reviews.review_heading: WCC is a good place for growing in spiritual life. Also, we can gain more knowledge there.
reviews.review_text: We are experiencing a good quality of campus life. Good hostel facilities, as a few friends are there, and the complaint is about the food only. We can get good food in the canteen. Also, sports are the best as they give more importance to sports quota students.

reviews.review_heading: Empowering Women in Excellence.
reviews.review_text: High quality multimedia lab with premium computers, updated software, and Wi-Fi are available. Clean and neat classrooms, editing suite, photography suite, and green matte studio. Hostel facilities are available with neat rooms. Sports facilities are provided with excellent coaches.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I'm satisfied with teaching and infrastructure, but not satisfied with the placements.
reviews.review_text: There is a library located in the college, LED screens in every classroom, and highly equipped labs. There are sports facilities, and they do conduct inter-department sports competitions and sports day. Physical education is compulsory to be completed in the first year of UG, but it is not good. Food experience is average, and there are good medical facilities for students.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good compared to others. The rooms are clean and good. Food which is provided in the mess also tastes well when compared to other hostels. Also, the hostel conducts many programs for students to showcase their talents.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the faculty members and management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is perfect. We don't lack anything. As far as I have heard from other colleges women's Christian college provides the best food and hostel facilities at a very minimum cost. Both veg and non-veg food are provided. Phone usage is prohibited during study hours. A day before the holiday, there will be no study hours. A common room is present in all hostels. The ancient building is perfectly maintained. We get to see how the infrastructure was built in the past and ...

reviews.review_heading: The honest review by a 2026 student.
reviews.review_text: There is a library with books covering all the topics. It also has a free Apollo pharmacy. We will have an assembly hour each week where there is a speaker to increase our knowledge about some topics.

reviews.review_heading: Women Christian College .
reviews.review_text: There are numerous facilities and factors available for the students on our campus. Some of them include a large library, which students can access during the day and is well-maintained and air-conditioned, Wi-Fi in most areas, and neatly set up computer and science labs. The hostel has all the homely facilities, and the food is also quite nice. There are 4 canteens and a few small shops too. The sports department also offers many games and activities.

reviews.review_heading: My best days in my college days .
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is very good. The lab, classrooms, and restrooms are always maintained very clean. The canteen is always good. If anyone has a medical problem, the medical room is always open. Our college supports so many sports, and they encourage the students to participate.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, average placements due to corona and layoffs.
reviews.review_text: There is a hostel inside the college where you are not allowed outside easily. It is very strict, but the environment in WCC looks beautiful with nature. I have also heard that it costs much to stay inside the WCC hostel. We do have a department library and a general library. We do have a lab, and for my UG IT department, we were using different classrooms to attend different subjects. Medical facilities are available. There is a canteen, but the break time won’t be enough to have lunch because ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: They provide better infrastructure and facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library, and classrooms available with separate departments. Hostel food quality is acceptable. The mess and canteen are very clean and hygienic. Medical facilities are available, and sports and games are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and better infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are very good. They provide Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and food. In our college hostel, they also provide electricity, food, and medical facilities. Sports and games are conducted every semester, and cultural events are performed.

reviews.review_heading: College with good faculty and facilities for the students.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure for the students in the Physiology course. The college has Wi-Fi, labs, a library, a canteen, hostels, sports facilities, etc. The facilities for the students are of good quality. The college hostel facilities are also of good quality. The mess food in the hostel is good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: A peaceful environment to excel in life.
reviews.review_text: Strong buildings; no damage happened during cyclone. We have gallery classrooms with laboratory of high facilities. The library is very big with innumerable books and AC facility. The food quality in mess is good; we have Apollo Shine care for medications. Only healthy food is provided, strictly. There are inter collegiate and intra departmental sports matches from time to time. Highly competitive environment for sports and games. The Sports day is the best event you have in the college.

reviews.review_heading: My college faculty is good and all facilities are available.
reviews.review_text: Although the hostel facilities are average, the affordability and quality of food are commendable. Moreover, the availability of medical facilities surpasses expectations. While the Wi-Fi connectivity in classrooms may be average, the laboratory infrastructure is top-notch. Certain blocks have excellent classrooms. The college takes pride in itself.

reviews.review_heading: Women's Christian College is a very disciplined college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure seems extremely wonderful. The facilities provided are very good. They have well-developed labs and a library. The food provided in the hostel is very good, but the timings are too early. The classrooms have a maximum of space. Phones are allowed inside the campus. The campus is filled with greenery.

reviews_list.review_title: College review by a student.

review_content.Placements: You get a year's internship in a college hospital. But you do not get paid for the internship. College does give you enough knowledge so that you can work at your preferred clinic. After graduation, there is a one-year college internship, and after that, you can work wherever you want.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have a complete and suitable campus, which is required for the medical courses. The campus consists of a hospital with ayurvedic treatment as well as modern medicine. The college also provides a library, which consists of all the books required to study the medical course.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Some facilities are good and some are average. Admission is done through a 3 category fee structure.

review_content.Placements: Every batch strength is 100 students, and every year it gets filled. Practicing with a Plan B.A.M.S. degree can get a salary of around Rs. 30,000 per month, varying according to places. Many ayurvedic pharmacy companies hire those who pass, and some start their practice. Top roles are a teacher in a medical college, entrepreneurship in Ayurveda, practitioners, and pursuing an MD and Ph.D. to boost opportunities.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college building and the hostel building are newly built. The environment is very good with lots of greenery around. The campus is big enough. Classrooms are ventilated naturally. Floor-wise washrooms are available, and classrooms are spacious. Hostel rooms are clean, though some are spacious and some are cramped. The college has provided access to a library and an e-library. The college does not have a certain canteen but has its mess. The food quality is good. Around the college campuses, lots of other messes are available.

paragraphs: GITAM University Hyderabad admission process 2026 is done systematically and consists of multiple stages. Each of these steps is broken down below:
STEP 1: GITAM School of Technology, Hyderabad Application Process 2026.

All the potential candidates desiring to be admitted to GITAM Hyderabad should commence with the online application. Applications to the institution are made on its official site. It is also the responsibility of applicants to ensure that they take their applications and pay the necessary application fee in time.
STEP 2: Screening and shortlisting of applications.

The university admits to the courses of Btech, BPharm, BA, BSc using different entrance exam scores, which include GAT, AP EAMCET, CAT, CUET, among others. Post selection requirements, students are required to go to the university campus to undergo the counselling process. It also takes into consideration the academic performance of the candidates to be selected.
STEP 3: Confirmation of Admission.

Once the group interview and personal interview sessions are complete, the institution shall inform the shortlisted candidates about their position in the institution. In this message, he or she will usually transmit it through email or other suitable channels. The selected candidates will need to pay the first instalment of the GITAM University Hyderabad fee before the stipulated deadline in order to be assured of their admission. This action makes them sure that they have a seat in the programme.

reviews.review_heading: It has great infrastructure and an average faculty. Placements are improving.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. Good quality of facilities is provided, but it can be better in terms of food. The hostel food is not as good as it should be. It provides everything, but the taste of the food is not good. We can eat it. The college conducts sports events.

reviews.review_heading: It offers a good environment and quality education. It is a bit expensive.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in the classrooms are basic. Some of them have air-conditioners, and some of them just have normal fans. As it is a private university, we have to pay for the luxury, and the same happens in the hostel. However, everything is well-maintained and clean.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college, best campus.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is everywhere and very fast. Digital classrooms are available, and some non-AC classrooms are also there. According to hostelers, food is good in both boys’ and girls’ hostels. Medical facilities are available. Sports facilities are good, and clubs are also well managed.

reviews.review_heading: Good college but Visakhapatnam college is better.
reviews.review_text: Hostel was good. There were four people in a room where you get your own bed, wardrobe, table, and chair. The meal quality was good, and you had it almost every day. You had a different menu. Wi-Fi was all over the campus. Library was good, and all types of books were available. There was also an e-library. Classrooms were spacious and digitally updated. Labs were spacious and had centralized AC.

reviews.review_heading: It is good on campus because of greenery and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostel food is really nice, and its hospitality is also nice. According to security purpose, it is really good for girls. Sports are also there, we can play badminton, hockey, cricket, etc. In hostel, there are carrom, chess, and gym facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: It has very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure available here is far better compared to other universities. Here, the rooms are neatly maintained with workers cleaning every day. All the classrooms, library, mess, and all are maintained with air conditioning and everyday cleaning.

reviews.review_heading: GITAM has a holistic kind of environment where students can study stress free.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities available in our campus, including Wi-Fi, computer labs, Library, playgrounds, and clubs. The facilities at the hostel are too good, including sports facilities, a gym, a medical room, a hostel library, and nicely furnished rooms. The quality of food is good in our hostel canteens.

reviews.review_heading: 2025 GITAM Hyderabad CSE review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, AC classrooms for university courses, and a vast library with thousands of books available for reading.  The hostel is good, but a little on the expensive side. The food is good in college hostels compared to other colleges. Canteen food is also delicious. A sports ground is available for playing.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, really good infrastructure with well-maintained equipment.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in my college are really good and well-maintained. We are provided with all the required things for our course. We have well-working Wi-Fi, AC classrooms with projectors, AI, and 360 degree cameras for better monitoring of students. The food in our college is the best. We have many varieties of food, and they are hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM University, Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. All department course infrastructure is good. The college provides Wi-Fi 24 hours a day. Labs are advanced. Classrooms are good. The library is very big and has all types of books. The hostel is good. Food is decent. In college, there are 3 canteens. Good facilities for medical and sports.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced experience: Decent teaching, good events, and scope for industry upgrades.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good. We have well-equipped labs, reliable Wi-Fi, clean classrooms, and library with good collection of books. Hostel rooms are neat and maintained regularly. Mess food has variety dishes with good taste. Sports facilities include a box cricket, indoor games. Basic medical help is available all time.

reviews.review_heading: All over good faculty members, average placements, good infrastructure, and bad food in hostel.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is good. Labs are fabulous. Classrooms are good, few are AC and few are non-AC. Wi-Fi is the issue nearby. Hostel is worse. Non taste food, common washrooms, no games, and medical is okay. The mess and canteen should improve a lot.

reviews.review_heading: My review of GITAM Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms are well-equipped with Wi-Fi routers, projectors, and smart CCTV cameras with AI detection technology to detect cheating in exams. The library is 3-floored and has almost everything we will need for our studies. It also has a separate workplace for digital work. The hostel is a bit expensive but good. It is comfortable with regular cleaning and attentive staff members. Mess food is relatively much better than other private colleges with delicious and a vast variety of meals. Howev...

reviews.review_heading: GITAM- A quick review based on my personal experience.
reviews.review_text: Great labs and well-maintained classrooms. The cafeteria serves good food. The sports areas are impressive with plenty of space and proper equipment. Overall, the campus infrastructure is solid and supports academics and extracurricular activities really well.

reviews.review_heading: A little bit satisfied because of good faculty members and placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is very nice. Classrooms are good. Labs are average. The hostel food is worth paying hostel fees. My college hostel has 3 blocks like A, B, and C. The food in the mess and canteen is good. Our college provides medical facilities, sports, and games.

paragraphs: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, SAS Nagar admissionsare mainly entrance-based. Also known as NIPER SAS Nagar or NIPER Mohali, it is a public pharmaceutical research institute established in 2007. In 2019, the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranked NIPER SAS Nagar 3rdin pharmaceutical studies. The institute offers admission to programmes at the PG and doctoral levels.  offers programmes such as MPharm, MS (Pharm), MBA (Pharm) and MTech (Pharm) at PG level. Applications for all the programmes are invited in online mode only. At the doctoral level, the University offers a PhD in different disciplines of Pharmacy. NIPER SAS Nagar admission is entrance-based. Read the following article to learn all about the courses, admission criteria, and process for the institute.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted for NIPER Mohali M.Tech (Pharm)?
faqs.answer: NIPER JEE is the accepted entrance exam for M.Tech admission at NIPER Mohali. M.Tech aspirants must apply and appear for NIPER JEE, which is conducted by NIPER Guwahati. reviews.review_text: There are facilities like air-conditioned classrooms and a library. Hostels are clean and spacious having moderate food. There are sports, medical, and canteen facilities too. reviews.review_heading: One of the best reputed college.
reviews.review_text: At our college, top-quality facilities are offered for the pharmacy courses. All types of required facilities were given to the students here. At the college, classrooms and labs were spacious enough with proper seating. The college also has its own hostel. Hostel mess food was good quality.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great campus and provides good education as well as infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members in our college are completely experienced and will help students to attain knowledge and even guide in their respective field. Labs are with all required equipment and instruments for the successful completion of the project work. There are many sports and gymnasium available On the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has an unsatisfactory course curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college and hostel was good. The library provides wanted information and will be helpful for a professional career. There is a vast platform for sports and games, so it depends on students to what extent they use it. The food served is not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to grow.
reviews.review_text: Our college is spread over 130 acres with 4 hostels, and it has a well-established infrastructure. There are 3 hostels for boys and one for girls with individual rooms. It has the best infrastructure and better facilities in every department. There is a separate block for every department.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college for the students who wants to pursue their Masters.
reviews.review_text: Excellent buildings, well maintained hostel rooms, digital classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, especially the library in which they are having large number of books related to various subjects, Library is equipped with air conditioning and the books available to lent for free for few days.

reviews.review_heading: NIPER - The excellence of pharma.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructural facilities of our college are excellent. I think very few institutions have this type of infrastructure across India. The institute is comparable to various institutions in aboard as well. The campus is eco-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Good Placement and really very nice infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Maximum facilities provided by NIPER that include Free Wi-Fi, Free hostel, swimming pool this facilites. In all labs AC are provided and lab for MS having well sophisticated instruments. In NIPER 5 hostel provided,  2 only boys, one for only girls, one for boys and girls and one married hostel is there. Hostels are well maintain and also mess facility provide in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to flourish because of resources and faculty. But, huge scope to improve on placements.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure is one of the institutes asset. Infrastructure includes AC classrooms, huge labs with sufficient laboratory equipments and reagents, hostels, computer centre, library, Wi-Fi, ambulance, gym, playground, cafeteria, swimming pool and many other. I did not faced issue with infrastructure. Food available from hostel is palatable and of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: I don't like the seniors behavior with the juniors they treat them like a servant.
reviews.review_text: In my college, there is no Wi-Fi facility available. I asked the management regarding it, and they said work was in progress, but I did not get any Wi-Fi facility until I completed my course. Food quality is good in a hostel, but it's so hot in August, so I think they should also provide some AC rooms for students in college.

A recent engineering college graduate in India should anticipate a starting monthly income of between Rs. 8,000 and Rs. 25,000. faqs.answer: Yes, students who pay fees at Saurashtra University are eligible for a refund. faqs.question: What is the application fee for B.Com at Saurashtra University?
faqs.answer: The application fee for BCom at Saurashtra University is around INR 160 . Cndidates must pay the application fee once the application form is submitted. Students can submit the application fee either in online or offline mode. For the online mode candidates can pay the Saurashtra University application fee via the debit/ credit card and for offline applicants can visit the office and pay via the demand draft mode.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA at Saurashtra University?
faqs.answer: For a minimum of two years, Saurashtra University provides a Master of Business Administration (MBA) with four specializations. The NAAC gives the varsity a grade of "A." Courses in Saurashtra University's MBA programme follow the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). The AICTE has given the programme approval. A bachelor's degree is required as the minimum eligibility to apply to the MBA program. Entrance exams like the GCET or CMAT are used to determine admission, which is then followed by a group discussion and interview. As for doing MBA programme in Saurashtra University, the fees structure upto INR 1,00,000 per annum.

faqs.question: What is the fees for B.Sc Information Technology course at Saurashtra University?
faqs.answer: As the course Bsc Information technology at Saurashtra University charges nearly 18,000 per year.As it was an three programme.It may includes 50 member of students into the course yearly. The faculty members possess a higher qualifications and had maximum experience as upto seven years in this teaching professions.They were attempting to teach us in a way that would be simple to understand for us. review_content.Placements: I'm answering from the perspective of placements for clinical psychology students and the placement cell is not equipped to find jobs in this field. Very few students and seniors opted for jobs posted by the placement cell, as most of them were not relevant. review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the most part, is good. Classrooms are spacious. Wi-Fi is not provided and signal access for mobile data can be weak. There were no sports or games during my stay, although they brought in some new additions towards the end of my stay. Cleanliness is not good in the JU hostels. We used to have rates in our corridors and there are no lift provisions, even though we have to go to the 5th floor to get food and water. The newer buildings are better. The food was mediocre in taste with a limited menu but there were 4-5 items served every day. I have witnessed complaints about the cleanliness of food as well. No medical facilities are provided by the hostel, even with the promise of medical insurance.

faqs.question: Q: Are admissions at SOGS, Jain (Deemed-to-be University) entrance-based or merit-based?

faqs.answer: Your application's acceptance for admission to SOGS, Jain (Deemed-to-be University) is contingent upon the particular programme you're applying for, be it undergraduate, graduate, or Diploma courses. This is an explanation: Programs for Undergraduates: The JET, or Jain Entrance Test, This university-specific admission exam is required for many undergraduate programs, especially those in education, law, and management. Grades for Class 12: Certain programs additionally take into account your 12th board test scores in related disciplines (CBSE, ICSE, etc.). Other National/State Level Entrance tests: The acceptance of results from tests such as JEE Main, NEET UG, KMAT Karnataka, and so on may vary according on the program. Postgraduate Programs: Master's Degree Entrance Tests (MDETs): Similar to JET for UG, SOGS conducts MDETs for specific PG programs like MBA, MCA, MSW, etc. National Level Entrance Exams: Scores from CAT, MAT, CMAT, XAT, GMAT, NMAT, etc., are widely accepted for MBA and other management programs. University Entrance Exams: For other PG programs, the university may conduct its own entrance exam or consider scores from exams like GATE, LSAT, etc.

Absolutely yes, SOGS, Jain (Deemed-to-be University) offers scholarship programmes for its courses.

For students to be eligible for these financial aids, they must fulfil certain conditions and eligibility criteria for the scholarships. All the applications received under academic and sports categories are scruitnised by the university's scholarship committee. The students are shortlisted for the scholarship based on their merit. Selected students receive a scholarship offer letter along with a scholarship acceptance form.

Students have to accept or decline their scholarship within the time frame indicated on the scholarship acceptance form. Failing to do so renders the scholarship offer invalid and the scholarship will no longer be available.

reviews.review_text: The facilities provided were Wi-Fi on campus, and more extra classes were taken at our college. Classrooms were large, and the labs were well-equipped with air-conditioned. The high library facilities provided more books. The hostel facilities were good. Canteen was also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college, but it has strict rules.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average, so I suggest others not to expect high. Labs are with low infrastructure. Canteen is average, but food quality and the taste is good. It has hostel facility, and it charges Rs. 70,000 per annum. Sports and games are not available, and they can't give a cricket bat.

reviews.review_heading: CMR College of Pharmacy is a good college if you only choose to pursue your B.Pharmacy degree.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is not up to the mark. Only certain departments of laboratories in our institute are well equipped. The library is also good as it provides us with various journals and the latest editions of textbooks for the students to refer. Canteen is good, but it's not up to the mark. The quality of food served keeps differing.

reviews.review_heading: I'll not recommend this course as it doesn't have scope in India and fee is also too high.
reviews.review_text: Open GATE campus with good infrastructure and green environment having play ground. College has its own hostel for boys and girls separately. Food is of good quality. Will have sports classes. But not that much regular. Each block has it's own library.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with excellent infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides high-speed Wi-Fi with regular labs and lab equipments like laminar air flow, autoclaves, incubators, and computers. There are projectors in air-conditioned classrooms, records, viva, assignments, an excellent hostel with full security, and good infrastructure. Not only studies but sports and cultural activities are also encouraged.
